body:
2026-06-04. I am working on audit hashes, ACL refresh, and image conditions. The purpose is to make the platform more dependable in actual use, with evidence that can be inspected rather than an assumption that a feature is complete.

What this changes

The implementation records a specific operating path and makes its controls visible. It creates a basis for later testing, correction, and review instead of treating the initial change as a final result.

Historical basis: 2026-06-04 repository milestone, commit 741fa08, 0a9121c.
